pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:0.5: ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā seyyasako anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.3: so tena kiso hoti lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.4: addasā kho āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ seyyasakaṃ kisaṃ lūkhaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātaṃ dhamanisanthatagattaṃ. disvāna āyasmantaṃ seyyasakaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.5: “kissa tvaṃ āvuso seyyasaka, kiso lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.6: kacci no tvaṃ āvuso seyyasaka, anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carasī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.8: ‘tena hi tvaṃ āvuso seyyasaka, yāvadatthaṃ bhuñja, yāvadatthaṃ supa, yāvadatthaṃ nahāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.9: yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṃ supitvā yāvadatthaṃ nahāyitvā yadā te anabhirati uppajjati, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti, tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocehī’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.12: atha kho āyasmā seyyasako yāvadatthaṃ bhuñji, yāvadatthaṃ supi, yāvadatthaṃ nahāyi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.13: yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṃ supitvā yāvadatthaṃ nahāyitvā, yadā anabhirati uppajjati, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti, tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ moceti .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.14: atha kho āyasmā seyyasako aparena samayena vaṇṇavā ahosi pīṇindriyo pasannamukhavaṇṇo vippasannachavivaṇṇo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.15: atha kho āyasmato seyyasakassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ seyyasakaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.16: “pubbe kho tvaṃ āvuso seyyasaka kiso ahosi lūkho dubbaṇṇo uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāto dhamanisanthatagatto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.17: so dāni tvaṃ etarahi vaṇṇavā pīṇindriyo pasannamukhavaṇṇo vippasannachavivaṇṇo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.18: kinnu kho tvaṃ āvuso seyyasaka bhesajjaṃ karosī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.20: apicāhaṃ yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjāmi, yāvadatthaṃ supāmi, yāvadatthaṃ nahāyāmi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.1.21: yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāvadatthaṃ supitvā yāvadatthaṃ nahāyitvā yadā me anabhirati uppajjati, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti, tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocemī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.1: ‘kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso seyyasaka yene’va hatthena saddhādeyyaṃ bhuñjasi, tene’va hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.4: ‘kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā seyyasako hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocessatī’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ seyyasakaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ seyyasakaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.7: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ seyyasaka hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesī”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.10: “ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.11: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.12: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito no sarāgāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.15: tattha nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā virāgāya dhamme desite sarāgāya cetessasi. visaññogāya dhamme desite saññogāya cetessasi. anupādānāya dhamme desite saupādānāya cetessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.16: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena rāgavirāgāya dhammo desito, madanimmadanāya, pipāsavinayāya, ālayasamugghātāya, vaṭṭupacchedāya, taṇhakkhayāya, virāgāya, nirodhāya, nibbānāya dhammo desito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.17: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena kāmānaṃ pahānaṃ akkhātaṃ kāmasaññānaṃ pariññā akkhātā, kāmapipāsānaṃ paṭivinayo akkhāto, kāmavitakkānaṃ samugghāto akkhāto, kāmapariḷāhānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.18: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss1:1.2.19: atha khvetaṃ moghapurisa appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā”ti.
